name: find_library
title: Find a library
description: Find the public library system for a city or library name and get its library_id. Call this first: every other tool needs the library_id. Covers library systems whose catalogue runs on BiblioCommons (e.g. Toronto, Vancouver, Chicago, Seattle, San Francisco, Boston, Ottawa, Calgary).

query.description: A city, region or library name, e.g. "Toronto", "Seattle Public Library", "King County".

library_id.description: Stacks id for the library system, e.g. 'tpl'. Pass this as `library` to every other tool.

verified.description: True if the catalogue was confirmed reachable (from the built-in directory or a live check).

matches.description: Best match first. Empty if no supported library was found.

engines.description: TinyFish endpoints that produced this result.

url.description: The page this data was read from.

cached.description: True if served from Stacks' short-lived cache.

retrieved_at.description: ISO timestamp of when the data was read from the site.

name: search_catalog
title: Search the catalogue
description: Search a library's catalogue for books, eBooks, audiobooks, DVDs and more. Returns typed titles with live availability counts and hold queues. Use the title_id of a result with check_availability to see which branches have a copy on the shelf.

library.description: Library system id such as "tpl" (Toronto), "vpl" (Vancouver), "chipublib" (Chicago). Get it from find_library. A city or library name also works.

query.description: What to search for: a title, author, subject or keywords. At most 200 characters.

format.description: Only this format: book, ebook, audiobook, eaudiobook, large_print, graphic_novel, picture_book, dvd, bluray, music_cd, magazine (or a platform format code such as BK).

available_at_branch.description: Only titles with a copy available right now at this branch (name or code from list_branches).

page.description: Results page. A page holds 20 titles at most libraries and 10 at some; `pages` gives the count.

total.description: Total matching titles across all pages.

did_you_mean.description: The site's spelling suggestion, if it had one.

title_id.description: Stable id for this edition. Pass to get_title, check_availability, estimate_wait, watch_title.

code.description: Platform format code, e.g. BK, EBOOK, DVD.

label.description: Human-readable format, e.g. Book, eBook, DVD.

status.description: available: a copy can be borrowed now. library_use_only: the only copies in are for reading inside the library, not for borrowing.

total_copies.description: Null when the site does not report a count.

available_copies.description: Copies the site counts as in. Null when the site does not report a count.

name: ask_library
title: Ask about a library's services
description: Answer an open-ended question about a library's services, policies or facilities by having a TinyFish Agent browse the library's own website. Use it for things the other tools do not cover, e.g. 'How do I get a card as a non-resident?', 'Can I book a study room at North York Central?', 'What are the overdue fines?'. Much slower than the other tools: a full answer usually takes 1 to 3 minutes. This call waits about 50 seconds; if the Agent is still working it returns status 'running' with a job_id, and you call get_job_result with that id until it is done.

library.description: Library system id such as "tpl" (Toronto), "vpl" (Vancouver), "chipublib" (Chicago). Get it from find_library. A city or library name also works.

question.description: The question, in plain language. Name the branch if it is about one branch.

job_id.description: Set while status is 'running'. Pass it to get_job_result.

found.description: False if the website does not state the answer.

pages_consulted.description: Pages found by search and read before the Agent started.

name: watch_title
title: Watch a title for availability
description: Create a standing watch on a title using TinyFish Monitor. TinyFish re-reads the title's page on a schedule and detects when its availability changes (for example a copy comes back on the shelf). Notifications go to the webhook you pass, or to the alerts set up in the TinyFish dashboard. Use list_watches to see watches and their current availability.

webhook_url.description: Optional public HTTPS endpoint TinyFish calls when the page changes.

name: health_check
title: Check that the tools still work
description: Run live checks against a library's website to confirm every Stacks tool still works, and report exactly what broke if the site changed. Checks page landmarks (TinyFish Fetch) and the data contract of each tool using known-good queries (TinyFish Browser). Set deep to also start a TinyFish Agent that inspects a failing page and explains what changed. Takes about 20 to 40 seconds. Run this when a tool returns SITE_CHANGED.

library.description: Library system id such as "tpl" (Toronto), "vpl" (Vancouver), "chipublib" (Chicago). Get it from find_library. A city or library name also works.

deep.description: If a check fails, start an Agent run to diagnose the failing page (result via get_job_result).

platform_version.description: Version of the library platform seen on the site now.

verified_platform_version.description: Platform version these tools were last verified against.

diagnosis_job_id.description: Pass to get_job_result for the Agent's diagnosis of the failing page.

diagnosis_error.description: Why the Agent diagnosis could not be started, if it could not.
